new_learnings.text: Hard block validation: 0.68:1 breadth + 81跌停 + IV Rank 1.0 across all ETFs = correct to hold 100% cash. V1 FOMO would have bought 永和/凯莱英/星宸 into panic. V2 preserves capital.
new_learnings.mechanism: Panic regime breadth <1:1 means selling pressure is broad and indiscriminate — even strong catalysts get overwhelmed by forced liquidation and systematic de-risking.

new_learnings.text: When every ETF proxy (500/科创50/创业板) simultaneously hits IV Rank 1.0, it signals systemic stress, not isolated sector vol. New entries face elevated gap risk. This is different from a single-sector IV spike.
new_learnings.mechanism: Cross-asset IV correlation at extremes means hedging demand is universal — options market pricing maximum uncertainty. Historical data shows this can precede both sharp reversals AND continued drawdowns, making it a 'wait for confirmation' signal rather than a contrarian buy.

new_learnings.text: Margin signal divergence is a useful secondary sort: 凯莱英 (+14% chg5, adding) and 星宸科技 (+3.4%, adding) show leveraged buyers accumulating on weakness, while most peers show deleveraging. When regime clears, adding-signal names likely recover first.
new_learnings.mechanism: Margin buyers are sophisticated leveraged participants. When they accumulate through a selloff (rather than de-lever), it signals conviction that the drawdown is a buying opportunity, not a fundamental deterioration.

new_learnings.text: Sector gravity > individual catalyst: 星宸科技 H1 +583% earnings growth is one of the strongest catalysts in the market, but 电子/半导体 sector is in freefall. V1 would have bought it; V2 correctly recognizes that sector headwinds overwhelm even exceptional stock-level catalysts in the short term.
new_learnings.mechanism: Institutional portfolios de-risk by sector, not by stock. When 电子/半导体 enters a de-rating cycle, even the strongest names get sold as part of sector allocation reduction. Stock-level catalysts take effect only after sector selling exhausts.

new_learnings.text: Only 2 of 20 enriched candidates are above MA20 (凯莱英 +5.3%, 昭衍新药 +19.5%). 15 of 20 have dist_ma20 < -15%. This extreme ratio confirms the selloff is broad and deep — not a 'stock picker's market.' The correct action is patience, not bargain hunting.
new_learnings.mechanism: When the majority of high-RPS candidates are deeply below their moving averages, the momentum regime has flipped from trending to mean-reverting. Mean-reversion environments punish trend-following entries and reward patience.
